title: In silico molecular docking, molecular dynamics, ADMET analysis of fucoidan against receptor frizzled-8 and coreceptor LRP6 in Wnt/beta-Catenin pathway and in vitro analysis of fucoidan extract from Sargassum echinocarpum as beta-catenin inhibitor in breast cancer cell line (MCF-7).
authors: Laeliocattleya, Rosalina Ariesta; Yunianta, Yunianta; Risjani, Yenny; Wulan, Siti Narsito
one_liner_zh: 该研究用分子对接和MD模拟岩藻多糖与Wnt通路受体Frizzled-8/LRP6的结合，但对象为糖-蛋白互作而非蛋白质-DNA，且无TF-DNA结合建模，仅方法部分可借鉴。
abstract: This study aimed to investigate the effect of fucoidan on the Wnt/beta-Catenin pathway using both in-silico molecular docking, molecular dynamics, ADMET analysis (in frizzled-8 receptor and LRP6 coreceptor) and in-vitro experiments using MCF-7 breast cancer cells. Through the molecular docking analysis, the binding energies on the frizzled-8 receptor were -5.6, -5.1, -9.4, and -8.8 kcal/mol, respectively. Meanwhile, those on the LRP6 receptor, were -7.3, -6.2, -10.0, and -9.8 kcal/mol, respectively. The results showed that fucoidan had a favorable binding affinity for both receptors. Furthermore, it was discovered to reduce the interaction and binding affinity between Wnt agonists to frizzled-8 and LRP6 receptors. This reduction was reflected in the change in the binding energy of the fucoidan-Wnt agonist-frizzled 8 and fucoidan-Wnt agonist-LRP6 complexes, which exhibited decreases of -7.0 kcal/mol and -7.8 kcal/mol, respectively. Fucoidan was found stable in complexes with frizzled-8 receptor and co-receptor LRP6. ADMET study showed it's non-carcinogenic and can be distributed in the body. Fucoidan effectively inhibited beta-catenin production, a critical factor in the Wnt/beta-catenin pathway. The MCF-7 breast cancer cells were treated with fucoidan extract from S. echinocarpum at incubation times of 24, 48, and 72 h, resulting in a reduction of beta-catenin levels by 95.19%, 83.88%, and 80.88%, respectively. Fucoidan also shows no significant difference in value compared to fucoidan standard (F. vesiculosus) and doxorubicin. Fucoidan exhibited antiproliferative effects against breast cancer cells, specifically through its modulation of the Wnt/beta-Catenin pathway, and held great potential as an herbal anticancer agent.Communicated by Ramaswamy H. Sarma.
abstract_zh: 本研究旨在通过计算机模拟分子对接、分子动力学、ADMET分析（针对frizzled-8受体和LRP6共受体）以及使用MCF-7乳腺癌细胞的体外实验，探讨岩藻多糖对Wnt/β-Catenin通路的影响。通过分子对接分析，frizzled-8受体上的结合能分别为-5.6、-5.1、-9.4和-8.8 kcal/mol。同时，LRP6受体上的结合能分别为-7.3、-6.2、-10.0和-9.8 kcal/mol。结果表明，岩藻多糖对这两种受体均具有有利的结合亲和力。此外，研究发现岩藻多糖能降低Wnt激动剂与frizzled-8和LRP6受体之间的相互作用及结合亲和力。这种降低反映在岩藻多糖-Wnt激动剂-frizzled 8和岩藻多糖-Wnt激动剂-LRP6复合物的结合能变化上，分别下降了-7.0 kcal/mol和-7.8 kcal/mol。岩藻多糖在与frizzled-8受体和共受体LRP6的复合物中保持稳定。ADMET研究表明其无致癌性，且能在体内分布。岩藻多糖有效抑制了β-catenin的产生，这是Wnt/β-catenin通路中的一个关键因子。MCF-7乳腺癌细胞用来自S. echinocarpum的岩藻多糖提取物处理，孵育时间为24、48和72小时，导致β-catenin水平分别降低了95.19%、83.88%和80.88%。岩藻多糖与标准岩藻多糖（F. vesiculosus）和阿霉素相比，数值上无显著差异。岩藻多糖对乳腺癌细胞表现出抗增殖作用，具体通过调节Wnt/β-Catenin通路实现，并具有作为草药抗癌剂的巨大潜力。由Ramaswamy H. Sarma通讯。
